title: Dad's Bluegrass Campground

services.name: Camper Cabin
services.desc: Campground/ RV Park Minutes from Nashville, TN and Bowling Green, Ky off I-65 Exit 6 We are here to help you rest, relax and renew as you travel from place to place. We are here whether you are here to rest for a night or two, need a place to rest after a day of sightseeing at our many available venues within minutes from us, or for families who want to spend time together in one place. Our affordable rates make it perfect for everyone! We offer warm hospitality, a fire ring, refreshing pool, hot showers at bath house for our cabins and tent sites and a fishing pond, coin operated laundry facilities and propane sales. We have washers/dryers, NEW playground, and basketball court, horseshoes
